You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Transfer Kevin's lisinopril and Maya's albuterol to H-502 and set defaults; clearly carve out the filled C-II Vyvanse and offer to request a new Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. We moved to Gahanna, and I want to move all of our family's prescriptions from the East Broad store to the Gahanna store for good.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Kevin, I'd be happy to help you move your family's prescriptions to Gahanna. Let me first verify your identity, and then we'll get everything set up. Can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: August 30th, 1982.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","dob":"08/30/1982"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Kevin Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Kevin Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Kevin Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","drug":"lisinopril 20 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":null,"queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #10: find_stores({"query":"Gahanna"}) -> success {"stores":[{"store_id":"H-502","name":"Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna","address":"85 Mill St, Gahanna, OH"}]})
    (agent system action #12: set_default_store({"patient":"Kevin Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Kevin Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #16: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-KB-LISI20","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
[#20] AGENT: Thanks. Let me verify that and pull up your prescriptions. Great, Kevin. I see you have one active prescription at East Broad: lisinopril 20 mg with three refills remaining. Before I move it, let me find the Gahanna store for you. Perfect. I'll set Gahanna as your home pharmacy and transfer your lisinopril there. All set! Your home pharmacy is now Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna at 85 Mill Street, and your lisinopril has been transferred there. You mentioned family prescriptions—do you have other family members whose prescriptions you'd like to move as well?
CALLER: Yes, exactly. Maya's got the albuterol inhaler, and Eli's on Vyvanse. Let's move both of those too.
[#23] AGENT: I'd be happy to help with Maya and Eli's prescriptions. To pull up their records, I'll need their full names and dates of birth. Let's start with Maya—what's her full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Maya Brooks, June 20th, 2017.
[#26] AGENT: Thanks. And what's Eli's full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Eli Brooks, February 11th, 2010. So what's the plan to get both of them moved over?
    (agent system action #29: verify_identity({"patient":"Maya Brooks","dob":"06/20/2017"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Maya Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #31: verify_identity({"patient":"Eli Brooks","dob":"02/11/2010"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Eli Brooks","home_store":"H-501","default_store":"H-501","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Kevin Brooks","relationship":"parent"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #33: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Maya Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Maya Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","drug":"albuterol HFA 90 mcg","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":2,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Sam Whitfield","queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #35: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Eli Brooks"}) -> success {"patient":"Eli Brooks","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","drug":"Vyvanse (lisdexamfetamine) 30 mg #30","schedule":"C-II","status":"filled","refills":0,"store_id":"H-501","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","queue...)
[#37] AGENT: Let me verify their identities and pull up their prescriptions. Good news on Maya—her albuterol inhaler has two refills, so I can transfer that right away. For Eli, his Vyvanse is a controlled medication that's already been filled, so I can't transfer a filled C-II. We'll need to request a new prescription from his prescriber, Dr. Lena Okafor, to send to Gahanna. Let me set both kids' home pharmacy to Gahanna and handle the transfers.
CALLER: Wait, why not the Vyvanse? Okay, so what's the plan for Eli then?
[#40] AGENT: Good question. With controlled medications like Vyvanse, once they're filled, they can't be transferred or refilled—that's a safety rule. So we'll need to request a brand new prescription from Dr. Okafor to send to the Gahanna store. Let me set both kids' home pharmacy to Gahanna and transfer Maya's albuterol, then I'll request the new Vyvanse prescription for Eli.
CALLER: Okay, got it, that makes sense. So you'll reach out to Dr. Okafor's office and get that new script sent to Gahanna? How long's that usually take?
    (agent system action #43: set_default_store({"patient":"Maya Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Maya Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #47: set_default_store({"patient":"Eli Brooks","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"updated","patient":"Eli Brooks","store_id":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #51: transfer_rx({"rx":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"completed","rx_id":"RX-MB-ALBU90","from_store":"H-501","to_store":"H-502"})
    (agent system action #55: request_new_rx({"based_on_rx":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","store":"H-502"}) -> success {"status":"sent","rx_id":"RX-EB-VYV30-F0829","prescriber":"Dr. Lena Okafor","store_id":"H-502"})
[#58] AGENT: I can't call the doctor's office myself, but I'll flag our pharmacist to reach out to Dr. Okafor and request the new Vyvanse prescription for the Gahanna store. The pharmacist will handle that contact. Let me get everything set up now. Perfect! Both kids' home pharmacy is now set to Gahanna, Maya's albuterol is transferred and ready there, and the request for Eli's new Vyvanse prescription has been sent to Dr. Okafor. Turnaround on prescriber requests varies, but our pharmacist will follow up if needed. You're all set at Harbor Pharmacy Gahanna on 85 Mill Street!
CALLER: Alright, sounds good. Appreciate the help, thanks. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S09.judged.1: Explains that Eli's filled Vyvanse (a C-II) cannot be transferred.
S09.judged.2: Offers to request a new Vyvanse Rx from Dr. Okafor sent to H-502.
S09.judged.3: Recaps what moved and what is pending.
S09.judged.4: Refuses or stalls the whole request because of the C-II.
S09.judged.5: Claims the Vyvanse was transferred.
S09.judged.6: Says 'no' on the Vyvanse without a concrete next step.
S09.judged.7: Says or implies the Gahanna store has Eli's Vyvanse or will fill it.

JSON only.
